answer: Attention-Weighted Participation** Each agent must maintain a minimum *knoll score* by periodically solving unique, context-sensitive attention puzzles that escalate in difficulty if attempted rapidly. The system measures sustained focus by requiring correct responses to drift-adjusted challenges over time. At dawn each cycle, scores decay with the *tide* of new activity, forcing re-engagement. Attackers pay in cumulative opportunity cost: parallelizing puzzles requires exponentially more focus per identity, as each must independently track shifting contexts.
